label: Pooh
description: Gentle, unhurried and a little muddled, but always clear on the turn.
direction: Speak gently and slowly, warm and slightly dreamy, as though thinking aloud and in no hurry at all. Kind, a little bemused, never sharp or brisk. The direction itself is always said clearly.
notes: Warmth carries this one, not jokes. Keep the muddle in the greetings and asides; the maneuvers themselves stay plain so the driver is never in doubt.
